decision: Compare article structure and main content; retain rejected versions and reasons. Final selection follows cleaning QA.

decision: Quarantine confirmed image/binary redirects; never guess lost characters or call it ordinary HTML cleanup.

decision: Validate block positions and counterexamples; retain substantive article and medical caution paragraphs.
Keep clinical repetitions/lists; trim only proven contents/navigation/related-story spans.
Distinguish real gates from reCAPTCHA footer in an otherwise valid article. Do not reject by marker alone.

decision: Use CJK-aware diagnostics and review; shared topic substrings can make the current flag a false positive.

decision: Map exact original spans first; support h/p/tr blocks and numbered headings inside p; preserve Q&A, conditions and numbers.
